author: RG72
attribution: Photo: RG72, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Internacia_Flughaveno_Zvartnoc_04.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Sixt car-rental counter, Zvartnots airport arrivals hall. Three fascia panels each with the SIXT logo; subtitles in Armenian (left), English (centre), Russian (right). People at the counter are seen from behind. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: RG72
attribution: Photo: RG72, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Monumento_al_%C4%A5inkalo_(Erevano).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Round illuminated sign on a stand outside the Mr. Gyros restaurant, Yerevan; the red fascia above the window repeats 'Մր. ԳԻՐՈՍ' with the same tagline. 'Մր.' is Armenian capital Մ with small ր. Small 'MG' logos omitted. Distractors: blue address plate '21/1 ԹՈՒՄԱՆՅԱՆ փող. TUMANYAN str.', 'Sorry we're CLOSED' tag, partial 'Armenian traditional cuisine' lettering. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: RaffiKojian
attribution: Photo: RaffiKojian, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Raffi_kojian-armenian_sign-104307958.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Unmodified original.

The shop name is Armenian only (Latin is just the generic 'FOOD'). Script signature at top-left is a distractor. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Narek Avetisyan /Narek75/
attribution: Photo: Narek Avetisyan /Narek75/, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Smart_Village_sign_in_Gusanagyugh.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.latin: Arqayablur ev Berdalanj amrotsner (Arqayablur and Berdalanj fortresses)
Hakob Hovhannisyani arvestanots (Hakob Hovhannisyan art studio)

notes: Village sights board in Gusanagyugh (Shirak). The Armenian lines use a display font whose letters resemble Latin (e.g. Ք looks like f, ր like r), a useful OCR trap. 'millenium' is spelled so on the sign. Sponsor logos at top right (EU for Armenia, giz, Berlin Hotel) and the QR code are distractors and not transcribed. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Stefan Bet-Mikhael
attribution: Photo: Stefan Bet-Mikhael, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bilingual_%22I_Love_Arzni%22_sign,_Armenian-Assyrian.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large free-standing letters at the entrance of Arzni village: 'ԻՍ', then a heart emblem with the Assyrian flag, then 'ԱՐԶՆԻ'. The red Syriac-script line above the heart (Assyrian Neo-Aramaic) is not transcribed. No Latin text. Passers-by at right are incidental.
